scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run gen:check && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: biome ci . && uv run --locked ruff check && uv run --locked ruff format --check
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run --locked ruff check --fix && uv run --locked ruff format
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/stage/page/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/stage/page/tsconfig.worklet.json && pyright
